0.name: TEXT_REGFSTETERNALCEREMONYPLANNER_00217_CLARIBEL_000_000
0.description: Greetings, good <hex:02080FE905FF066D6164616DFF0473697203>. My name is Claribel, and I have the honor to assist those happy couples who wish to be joined in the sight of gods and men.

1.name: TEXT_REGFSTETERNALCEREMONYPLANNER_00217_SYSTEM_000_001
1.description: The special quest “The Ties that Bind” is available to those who have completed the quest “The Scions of the Seventh Dawn” and have obtained a promise wristlet.

2.name: TEXT_REGFSTETERNALCEREMONYPLANNER_00217_SYSTEM_000_002
2.description: There exist three varieties of wristlets, each of which may be acquired via the online store.

3.name: TEXT_REGFSTETERNALCEREMONYPLANNER_00217_SYSTEM_000_003
3.description: Wristlets are sent to you via the moogle delivery service. By equipping a wristlet, the aforementioned quest will become available from Claribel.

4.name: TEXT_REGFSTETERNALCEREMONYPLANNER_00217_SYSTEM_000_004
4.description: When accepting this quest, please ensure that you are in a party of two with your partner, who must also be equipped with a wristlet.

6.name: TEXT_REGFSTETERNALCEREMONYPLANNER_00217_CLARIBEL_000_021
6.description: It was an honor and a pleasure both to serve you. If there is aught else I might do for you, please do not hesitate to ask.

7.name: TEXT_REGFSTETERNALCEREMONYPLANNER_00217_Q1_000_021
7.description: Do you require help with something?

8.name: TEXT_REGFSTETERNALCEREMONYPLANNER_00217_A1_000_021
8.description: No, thank you. Everything is well.

9.name: TEXT_REGFSTETERNALCEREMONYPLANNER_00217_A1_000_022
9.description: Actually...I'm thinking about holding another ceremony.

10.name: TEXT_REGFSTETERNALCEREMONYPLANNER_00217_CLARIBEL_000_030
10.description: I am glad to hear that. May the Twelve ever shine Their countenances upon you and your beloved.

11.name: TEXT_REGFSTETERNALCEREMONYPLANNER_00217_CLARIBEL_000_040
11.description: Another ceremony, my <hex:02080FE905FF056C616479FF056C6F726403>? I take it to mean that you wish to be joined to another. I shall explain the process that you may undertake to begin anew.

12.name: TEXT_REGFSTETERNALCEREMONYPLANNER_00217_SYSTEM_000_041
12.description: If you wish to form an eternal bond with a new partner, you must first have your existing bond annulled by relinquishing your eternity ring to the Sanctum acolyte.

13.name: TEXT_REGFSTETERNALCEREMONYPLANNER_00217_SYSTEM_000_042
13.description: Next, access the online store and acquire a new promise wristlet, which will be sent to you via the moogle delivery service.

14.name: TEXT_REGFSTETERNALCEREMONYPLANNER_00217_SYSTEM_000_043
14.description: By equipping a wristlet, the special quest “The Ties that Bind” will become available from Claribel. When accepting this quest, please ensure that you are in a party of two with your partner, who must also be equipped with a wristlet.
